title: Cozy & Convenient | Sleeps 8 | 12 Min to Downtown
description:
Welcome to your Nashville home away from home—Why you'll love this beautifully renovated, spacious retreat:
Multiple Bedrooms + En Suites – ideal for groups, families (no children under 4) & business stays
Minutes to BNA Airport – perfect for easy arrivals & departures
Quick drive to Downtown Nashville – live music, Broadway, restaurants, and top Music City attractions & major events
4 miles to Tanger shopping outlets
No Smoking, No Pets
Must provide valid driver license within 24 hrs of booking

Other things to note
A few helpful details before you book:

- Parking includes space for 1 vehicle in the driveway, with room for up to 2 additional cars parked on the street

- Sleeping accommodations include 2 bedrooms downstairs with en suite bathrooms and 2 bedrooms upstairs

- For safety and property security, exterior cameras are located outside the home

- Primary booking guest must provide a valid driver license via Airbnb messages

- Uphill driveway and staircase inside the home may limit access for those with mobility concerns or those requiring wheelchair access

- Please observe quiet hours between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM

- To help us maintain a clean and enjoyable environment, we do not allow pets or smoking, and the property is not baby-proofed or set up to accommodate children under 4 years old. Thank you for your understanding!
